item.title: Scheduled CoreWeave Network Maintenance - US-EAST-02B
item.description:
September 1, 2026 1:14AM UTC
Scheduled - CoreWeave will be performing scheduled InfiniBand network maintenance on Wednesday, September 2, 2026, from 1:00 PM ET (5:00 PM UTC) to 3:00 PM ET (7:00 PM UTC) in US-EAST-02B

Location:
US-EAST-02B

During this window, our network engineering team will upgrade the InfiniBand fabric. The components are upgraded one at a time so that InfiniBand fabric management remains available throughout the maintenance.

Impact:
We anticipate minimal impact. InfiniBand connectivity within this site should remain available for the duration of the window; however, during the failover between redundant components there
is a small chance of a brief interruption to workloads using the affected fabric.

We will be actively monitoring the situation during this time. We appreciate your patience and understanding. If you have any further questions or require assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team at support@coreweave.com.

This activity is deemed Planned Maintenance under the CoreWeave Terms of Service Maintenance Policy ( docs.coreweave.com/policies/terms-of-service/maintenance-policy )

September 2, 2026 5:00PM UTC
Active - This maintenance has started.

item.title: Degraded Grafana Metrics Performance — US-EAST
item.description:
September 2, 2026 2:05AM UTC
Investigating - We're investigating degraded performance with metrics in US-EAST. Querying US-EAST metrics in Grafana may be slow or return intermittent errors. Metric ingestion is degraded, but no metric data is being lost, and customer workloads are not affected. We'll provide updates as we remediate.

September 2, 2026 7:00AM UTC
Identified - We have identified the cause of the metrics degradation and are actively working on a fix. We have also taken steps to stabilize the metrics query endpoints, and we continue to monitor overall system health. We will share further updates as remediation progresses.

item.title: Scheduled CoreWeave Electrical Maintenance - US-EAST-04A
item.description:
August 28, 2026 6:15PM UTC
Scheduled - Details: CoreWeave will be performing electrical maintenance from Monday, August 31 at 12:00 UTC through Friday, September 4 at 21:00 UTC that will affect the UPS systems supporting one data hall in our US-EAST-04A facility.

Impact: No impact to compute, storage, or network availability is expected and no customer action is required. Critical load is maintained by generator power while UPSs are unavailable. While a lineup is on maintenance bypass, that lineup operates without UPS battery ride-through, which is a temporary reduction in power redundancy. Utility power remains available throughout.

We will be actively monitoring the situation during this time. We appreciate your patience and understanding. If you have any further questions or require assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team at support@coreweave.com

This activity is deemed Planned Maintenance under the CoreWeave Terms of Service Maintenance Policy ( https://docs.coreweave.com/policies/terms-of-service/maintenance-policy )

August 31, 2026 12:00PM UTC
Active - Scheduled maintenance is starting.

item.title: Object Storage Performance Degradation in US-WEST-01A
item.description:
August 27, 2026 3:37AM UTC
Investigating - We are investigating elevated error rates and increased latency for Object Storage in the US-WEST-01A region. Requests to this region may intermittently return HTTP 503 responses or take longer than usual to complete. Our engineering team is actively engaged and working to identify the root cause.

August 27, 2026 9:03AM UTC
Identified - We have identified the issue and are continuing to work on a resolution at this time.

August 27, 2026 10:49AM UTC
Monitoring - We've implemented a fix to address the object storage latency and error codes in US-WEST-01A.
All services are now fully operational, and we are monitoring closely to ensure stability.

 If you continue to see issues, please reach out to support@coreweave.com.

August 27, 2026 1:19PM UTC
Investigating - We are investigating renewed elevated error rates and increased latency for object storage in US-WEST-01A. A change applied earlier today improved service for a period, but the degradation has returned and our engineering team is actively engaged and working to identify the root cause. Clients may see intermittent 503 responses.

August 27, 2026 7:28PM UTC
Monitoring - We believe the issues affecting latency have been resolved, and the impacted service is now operational.

We are closely monitoring the environment to ensure stability and will post another update if we observe any recurrence or unexpected behavior prior to resolving.
If you are still seeing issues, please reach out to support@coreweave.com.

August 27, 2026 8:47PM UTC
Resolved - We believe the issue is resolved, and our services are now operational.

If you are continuing to experience issues, please reach out to support@coreweave.com.
